# skatR

**skatR** is a toolkit for analysing and simulating the German card game
**Skat**. It provides trick play and scoring for suit, grand, and null
games, game-value computation, players spanning rule-based heuristics
through determinized Monte Carlo to an exact double-dummy solver, Monte
Carlo simulation over many deals, and tidy analysis and visualisation of
outcomes.

The caller supplies a resolved contract and the final ten-card hands
plus skat. Bidding, skat pickup/discard decisions, overbidding, and a
tournament manager are outside the current engine.
[`sk_ruleset()`](https://r-heller.github.io/skatR/reference/sk_ruleset.md)
stores variant metadata; play and scoring do not consume Bock, Ramsch,
or Kontra settings.

Hand games include the skat in the declarer’s card points and matador
count. Automatic values include achieved Schneider/Schwarz; announced
levels and ouvert are checked explicitly. Corrected scores can differ
from earlier releases. `game_value` means the complete scoring value,
not the player’s bid.

## Installation

``` r

# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("r-heller/skatR")
```

## Quick start

Deal a hand and play it out. Every seat is a strategy object, so the
same call covers random, heuristic, and search-based play.

``` r

library(skatR)

deal <- sk_deal(seed = 42)
game <- sk_play_game(deal$hands, deal$skat, declarer = 1, game_type = "grand")
game$result
#> <sk_result>: declarer lost
#> • Game value: 120
#> • Score: -240
#> • Schneider: yes
#> • Schwarz: no
```

Repeat it a few hundred times to see how a configuration performs.

``` r

sim <- sk_simulate(n = 500, game_type = "grand", seed = 1, verbose = FALSE)
mean(sim$won)
#> [1] 0.242

sk_plot_points(sim)
```

![Histogram of declarer card points across 500 simulated grand games,
filled by whether the declarer won, with a dashed line at the 61-point
winning threshold.](reference/figures/README-simulate-1.png)

Or solve an endgame exactly. The double-dummy solver runs an alpha-beta
search in C++ and returns the card points the declarer can guarantee
against perfect defence.

``` r

hands <- list(c("CJ", "SA"), c("HA", "H9"), c("DA", "D9"))
sk_solve_dd(hands, game_type = "grand", declarer = 1)
#> [1] 35
```

## What is in the box

| Area | Functions |
|----|----|
| Cards and ordering | [`sk_full_deck()`](https://r-heller.github.io/skatR/reference/sk_full_deck.md), [`sk_card()`](https://r-heller.github.io/skatR/reference/sk_card.md), [`sk_points()`](https://r-heller.github.io/skatR/reference/sk_points.md), [`sk_card_order()`](https://r-heller.github.io/skatR/reference/sk_card_order.md), [`sk_strength()`](https://r-heller.github.io/skatR/reference/sk_strength.md), [`sk_is_trump()`](https://r-heller.github.io/skatR/reference/sk_is_trump.md), [`sk_effective_suit()`](https://r-heller.github.io/skatR/reference/sk_effective_suit.md) |
| Bidding | [`sk_base_value()`](https://r-heller.github.io/skatR/reference/sk_base_value.md), [`sk_matadors()`](https://r-heller.github.io/skatR/reference/sk_matadors.md), [`sk_game_value()`](https://r-heller.github.io/skatR/reference/sk_game_value.md) |
| Play and scoring | [`sk_legal_moves()`](https://r-heller.github.io/skatR/reference/sk_legal_moves.md), [`sk_trick_winner()`](https://r-heller.github.io/skatR/reference/sk_trick_winner.md), [`sk_count_points()`](https://r-heller.github.io/skatR/reference/sk_count_points.md), [`sk_score_game()`](https://r-heller.github.io/skatR/reference/sk_score_game.md) |
| Players | [`sk_player()`](https://r-heller.github.io/skatR/reference/sk_player.md), [`sk_choose()`](https://r-heller.github.io/skatR/reference/sk_choose.md), [`sk_mcts_move()`](https://r-heller.github.io/skatR/reference/sk_mcts_move.md) |
| Solver | [`sk_solve_dd()`](https://r-heller.github.io/skatR/reference/sk_solve_dd.md) |
| Simulation | [`sk_deal()`](https://r-heller.github.io/skatR/reference/sk_deal.md), [`sk_play_game()`](https://r-heller.github.io/skatR/reference/sk_play_game.md), [`sk_simulate()`](https://r-heller.github.io/skatR/reference/sk_simulate.md) |
| Plots | [`sk_plot_points()`](https://r-heller.github.io/skatR/reference/sk_plot_points.md), [`sk_plot_winrate()`](https://r-heller.github.io/skatR/reference/sk_plot_winrate.md) |
| Rules and demo | [`sk_ruleset()`](https://r-heller.github.io/skatR/reference/sk_ruleset.md), [`sk_run_app()`](https://r-heller.github.io/skatR/reference/sk_run_app.md) |

[`vignette("skatR")`](https://r-heller.github.io/skatR/articles/skatR.md)
walks through all of it in order.

# Package index

## Cards and ordering

The 32-card deck, and how its cards rank under each game type.

- [`sk_suits`](https://r-heller.github.io/skatR/reference/skat-constants.md)
  [`sk_ranks`](https://r-heller.github.io/skatR/reference/skat-constants.md)
  [`sk_card_points`](https://r-heller.github.io/skatR/reference/skat-constants.md)
  : Skat card constants
- [`sk_full_deck()`](https://r-heller.github.io/skatR/reference/sk_full_deck.md)
  : A full 32-card Skat deck
- [`sk_card()`](https://r-heller.github.io/skatR/reference/sk_card.md) :
  Construct a Skat card
- [`format(`*`<sk_card>`*`)`](https://r-heller.github.io/skatR/reference/format.sk_card.md)
  [`print(`*`<sk_card>`*`)`](https://r-heller.github.io/skatR/reference/format.sk_card.md)
  [`` `[`( ``*`<sk_card>`*`)`](https://r-heller.github.io/skatR/reference/format.sk_card.md)
  : Format and print Skat cards
- [`sk_suit_of()`](https://r-heller.github.io/skatR/reference/sk_suit_of.md)
  : Extract the suit of a card
- [`sk_rank_of()`](https://r-heller.github.io/skatR/reference/sk_rank_of.md)
  : Extract the rank of a card
- [`sk_points()`](https://r-heller.github.io/skatR/reference/sk_points.md)
  : Card-point value of one or more cards
- [`sk_game_types()`](https://r-heller.github.io/skatR/reference/sk_game_types.md)
  : Game types
- [`sk_card_order()`](https://r-heller.github.io/skatR/reference/sk_card_order.md)
  : Trick-taking order for a game type
- [`sk_strength()`](https://r-heller.github.io/skatR/reference/sk_strength.md)
  : Numeric strength of cards under a game type
- [`sk_is_trump()`](https://r-heller.github.io/skatR/reference/sk_is_trump.md)
  : Test whether a card is a trump
- [`sk_effective_suit()`](https://r-heller.github.io/skatR/reference/sk_effective_suit.md)
  : The effective suit a card follows

## Bidding

Game values (Reizwerte) and the matador multiplier.

- [`sk_base_value()`](https://r-heller.github.io/skatR/reference/sk_base_value.md)
  : Base value of a game type
- [`sk_matadors()`](https://r-heller.github.io/skatR/reference/sk_matadors.md)
  : Count matadors (Spitzen)
- [`sk_game_value()`](https://r-heller.github.io/skatR/reference/sk_game_value.md)
  : Game value (Reizwert)

## Play and scoring

Trick mechanics and the outcome of a completed game.

- [`sk_legal_moves()`](https://r-heller.github.io/skatR/reference/sk_legal_moves.md)
  : Legal cards to play
- [`sk_trick_winner()`](https://r-heller.github.io/skatR/reference/sk_trick_winner.md)
  : Determine the winner of a completed trick
- [`sk_count_points()`](https://r-heller.github.io/skatR/reference/sk_count_points.md)
  : Total card points in a set of cards
- [`sk_score_game()`](https://r-heller.github.io/skatR/reference/sk_score_game.md)
  : Score a completed Skat game

## Players

Strategies that pick a card to play.

- [`sk_player()`](https://r-heller.github.io/skatR/reference/sk_player.md)
  : Create a Skat player
- [`sk_choose()`](https://r-heller.github.io/skatR/reference/sk_choose.md)
  : Ask a player to choose a card
- [`sk_mcts_move()`](https://r-heller.github.io/skatR/reference/sk_mcts_move.md)
  : Determinized Monte Carlo move selection

## Solver

Exact double-dummy endgame analysis.

- [`sk_solve_dd()`](https://r-heller.github.io/skatR/reference/sk_solve_dd.md)
  : Solve a double-dummy Skat endgame

## Simulation and visualisation

Deal, play, repeat, and look at the results.

- [`sk_deal()`](https://r-heller.github.io/skatR/reference/sk_deal.md) :
  Deal a Skat game
- [`sk_play_game()`](https://r-heller.github.io/skatR/reference/sk_play_game.md)
  : Play out a full Skat game
- [`sk_simulate()`](https://r-heller.github.io/skatR/reference/sk_simulate.md)
  : Simulate many Skat games
- [`sk_plot_points()`](https://r-heller.github.io/skatR/reference/sk_plot_points.md)
  : Plot the distribution of declarer card points
- [`sk_plot_winrate()`](https://r-heller.github.io/skatR/reference/sk_plot_winrate.md)
  : Plot win rate by game type

## Rulesets and app

Rule variants and the interactive demo.

- [`sk_ruleset()`](https://r-heller.github.io/skatR/reference/sk_ruleset.md)
  : Define a Skat ruleset
- [`is_sk_ruleset()`](https://r-heller.github.io/skatR/reference/is_sk_ruleset.md)
  : Test whether an object is a ruleset
- [`sk_run_app()`](https://r-heller.github.io/skatR/reference/sk_run_app.md)
  : Launch the skatR demo Shiny app
